description.value: Bare Bones Fish House & Smokery is a casual seafood and smoked-meat restaurant with locations in Parksville and Port Alberni, serving comfort food made from fresh ingredients. The menu spans crispy fish and chips (including a gluten-free version), smoked meat tacos, seafood bowls, and vegan options. Cyclists will find both a relaxed indoor dining room and all-season outdoor seating on a dog-friendly patio.

The OSM name 'Bare Bones Fish and Chips' differs from the website name 'Bare Bones Fish House & Smokery' — this is flagged as a concern. Washrooms are confirmed by a customer review ('clean bathrooms'). Takeout is confirmed by the website's online ordering feature; vegan/GF options are confirmed by menu descriptions ('Sunshine Vegan Bowl', 'gluten-free fish and chips').
